title: TypeScript Compiler Options
description: Configuration options for the TypeScript compiler (tsconfig.json compilerOptions)

target.description: ECMAScript target version for emitted JavaScript

strictNullChecks.description: Raise errors on expressions that may be null or undefined

noImplicitAny.description: Raise error on expressions and declarations with an implied 'any' type

esModuleInterop.description: Enables emit interoperability between CommonJS and ES modules

outDir.description: Redirect output structure to the directory

rootDir.description: Specify the root directory of input files

declaration.description: Generates corresponding .d.ts file for each TypeScript file

declarationMap.description: Generates a sourcemap for each corresponding .d.ts file

sourceMap.description: Generates corresponding .map file for emitted JavaScript

lib.description: List of library files to be included in the compilation

paths.description: Path mapping entries for module names to locations

baseUrl.description: Base directory to resolve non-relative module names

emitDecoratorMetadata.description: Enables experimental support for emitting type metadata for decorators

skipLibCheck.description: Skip type checking of declaration files
